messages:
deploy-bot: preflight: chart=orders-v5.7 detected values drift: db.pool.size expected=20 actual=50 in 6/12 canary pods. severity=warn. preflight failed on readiness probe in 3 pods. cmd: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=orders -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].env}'`
jess: that explains the OOMs we saw in canary. who bumped pool size to 50? overlay or chart?
omar: checking commit history — overlay `team-orders/canary-values.yaml` has `db.pool.size: 50`. chart version promoted is 5.7.0 which did not change pool size. overlay accidentally merged yesterday.
lina: change window open for 90m. options: abort promotion, pin db.pool.size back to 20 during promote, or proceed and isolate canary. I prefer pin + keep canary running for diagnostics.
jess: agreed. Plan: promote chart 5.7.0 but set `--set db.pool.size=20` and add audit tag. keep canary labelled `env=canary`.
omar: commands:
```bash
# promote with pin
helm upgrade orders-release charts/orders --namespace prod --version 5.7.0 \
  --reuse-values \
  --set db.pool.size=20 \
  --set imagePromotion.note=pin-dbpool-2026-04-20
# ensure canary pods are labeled
kubectl -n prod label deployment orders-svc env=canary --overwrite
```
jess: rollback surface: `helm rollback orders-release 12` to previous rev and remove pin. Immediate mitigation if things go bad: scale down canary replicas `kubectl -n prod scale deployment orders-svc --replicas=0 -l env=canary`.
lina: add to release notes: "Pinned db.pool.size=20 for rollout; canary instances observed db.pool.size=50 — follow-up to reconcile overlays." create ticket RD-6077.
deploy-bot: scheduled watch: orders-startup-watch (45m). thresholds: pod_ready_latency>25s, pod_oom>0, restart_count>2.
omar: helm dry-run/helm template diff:
```diff
--- a/templates/deployment.yaml
+++ b/templates/deployment.yaml
@@
-        - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
-          value: "50"
+        - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
+          value: "20"  # pinned for rollout
```
jess: running promote now after dry-run verified. will post completion ts. tagging RD-6077 in release notes.
release-manager: note: document the manual pin in audit log and ping infra-oncall for 30m. keep release-note short.
jess: promote executed at 3979998910. Helm upgrade succeeded, rollout finished. Canaries (6 pods) left labelled env=canary and still showing pool=50 for analysis.
lina: monitoring looks ok; saw a brief increase in connection latency during startup then recovered. keeping the 45m watch.
release-manager: decision: proceed with pinned rollout. action items: RD-6077 assigned to @omar and @jess to reconcile overlays and schedule a point release to align values. close thread after watch if stable. :white_check_mark:"
